name: Question 8
worked_solution:
First, we multiply the numerator and the denominator of our expression by $\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta +1.$ This gives:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta \,\operatorname{cot}⁡\theta }{\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta -1} & =\frac{\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta \,\operatorname{cot}⁡\theta }{\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta -1}\cdot \frac{\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta +1}{\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta +1} \\  & =\frac{\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta \,\operatorname{cot}⁡\theta \,(\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta +1)}{{csc}^{2}⁡\theta -1}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, using the identity ${csc}^{2}⁡\theta -1={cot}^{2}⁡\theta $, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta \,\operatorname{cot}⁡\theta \,(\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta +1)}{{csc}^{2}⁡\theta -1} & =\frac{\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta \,\operatorname{cot}⁡\theta \,(\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta +1)}{{cot}^{2}⁡\theta } \\  & =\frac{\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta \,\cancel{\operatorname{cot}⁡\theta }\,(\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta +1)}{\cancel{\operatorname{cot}⁡\theta }\cdot \operatorname{cot}⁡\theta } \\  & =\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta \,\operatorname{tan}⁡\theta \,(\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta +1) \\  & =\cancel{\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta }\cdot \frac{\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta }{\cancel{\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta }}\,(\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta +1) \\  & =\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta \,(\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta +1) \\  & =\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta \,\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta +\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta  \\  & =\cancel{\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta }\cdot \frac{1}{\cancel{\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta }}+\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta  \\  & =1+\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta .\end{aligned}
$$

EXPLANATION

First, we multiply the numerator and the denominator of our expression by csc⁡θ+1. This gives:

cos⁡θcot⁡θcsc⁡θ−1=cos⁡θcot⁡θcsc⁡θ−1⋅csc⁡θ+1csc⁡θ+1=cos⁡θcot⁡θ(csc⁡θ+1)csc2⁡θ−1

Now, using the identity csc2⁡θ−1=cot2⁡θ, we have

cos⁡θcot⁡θ(csc⁡θ+1)csc2⁡θ−1=cos⁡θcot⁡θ(csc⁡θ+1)cot2⁡θ=cos⁡θcot⁡θ(csc⁡θ+1)cot⁡θ⋅cot⁡θ=cos⁡θtan⁡θ(csc⁡θ+1)=cos⁡θ⋅sin⁡θcos⁡θ(csc⁡θ+1)=sin⁡θ(csc⁡θ+1)=sin⁡θcsc⁡θ+sin⁡θ=sin⁡θ⋅1sin⁡θ+sin⁡θ=1+sin⁡θ.
